messages:
tara: quick sync — proposing we standardize how SDKs map API error payloads -> exceptions. idea: ClientError for 4xx, ServerError for 5xx, StreamError for streaming frames. always attach request_id and raw_status in the exception object.

leo: +1 to structured exceptions. question: do we put request_id on the top-level error message, or a .metadata map? most langs prefer a field rather than nested dict.

sam: prefer explicit fields: .request_id and .http_code. keeps it ergonomic in Go and TS.

tara: ok that matches my thinking. also want a debug hook that can log full response body when DEBUG_SDK=1. minimal by default.

leo: small nits per-lang: Go error interface -> we can add helpers: func IsClientError(err error) bool and GetRequestID(err error) string. in Python we can subclass Exception and attach attrs.

sam: streaming quirk: when connection drops mid-stream the server returns 499 with body {"error":"stream_aborted","request_id":"..."} — SDKs should raise StreamError immediately and expose the last partial chunk plus request_id.

tara: exactly. sample TS surface I sketched:
```ts
class ClientError extends Error {
  request_id?: string;
  http_code?: number;
  raw?: any;
}

// usage in client:
if (status >= 400 && status < 500) throw new ClientError(msg);
```

leo: pinging code-review: @sam can you add the Go helpers in your PR and wire the debug env flag? small tests to assert request_id is preserved.

sam: on it — will add tests and a minimal fixture response for streaming-abort.

devops-bot: deploy-pipeline: CI triggered for branch sam/err-surface (job: unit-tests, lint).

leo: logging guidance: make SDK log lines include rid at start e.g. "rid=abcd1234 client: auth failed" so ops can grep. avoid printing API keys.

tara: +1. action items: 1) sam: add exceptions + tests; 2) leo: implement Go helpers + docs snippet; 3) tara: update devex doc with recommended shape and env var. target end-of-week for merged changes.

sam: timeline ok. will notify when PR ready for review.

leo: one more edge: for retries, if we attach request_id then when retrying a request you get a new request_id per attempt. make it clear in logs which rid is which (prefix with attempt #).

tara: good catch. docs note: "request_id is per attempt — logs include attempt=N rid=..."

sam: also adding a small debug helper to correlate: 
```bash
# show last N sdk logs for rid
rg "rid=abcd" logs/ | tail -n 200
```

leo: OK, finishing async review. will leave inline comments on the PR. :thumbsup:

tara: thanks team — will follow up in doc and drop a small example in the SDK readme.
